title: Village Water Audit Day
summary: Walk every restored source in the cluster, record readings and publish the results the same evening.
description: Volunteers join a village water committee member for a full day of flow measurements, water quality strips and photo records at each restored borewell. Results are collated on site and published to the project page before midnight.
highlights: Half-day field training before you start
Every reading published the same evening
Lunch provided by the village committee

title: Reading Mentor Induction
summary: A one-day induction into the level-based reading rubric used by every learning centre.
description: Facilitators and volunteers are trained on the shared assessment rubric, grouping children by reading level, and running a two-hour evening session. The day ends with a practice assessment marked against sample work.
highlights: Placement in one of the 24 running centres

title: Mobile Health Camp — Volunteer Call
summary: Help run registration, referral follow-up and the dispensing counter at the December camp.
description: Volunteers staff the registration desk, keep the referral log, and accompany the counsellor for follow-up visits in the afternoon. Prior medical experience is welcome but not required for registration and log-keeping roles.
highlights: Short briefing at 08:30 before the camp opens

title: Watershed Planting Week
summary: Five days of planting along freshly cut contour trenches on the ridge.
description: A week-long planting drive on the treated ridge. Each day covers one section, with saplings issued against a signed register and survival counted at the end of the week.
highlights: Survival percentages published after six months

title: Annual Transparency Forum
summary: The yearly open session where budgets, audits and programme results are presented and questioned.
description: Programme heads present year-on-year results against the published budgets, followed by an open floor. Minutes and the slide pack are attached to the annual report page.
highlights: Open floor questions taken from the audience
Audit observations read out in full
Minutes published with the annual report

title: Library Corner Handover
summary: Handover of the sixtieth and final library corner, closing the project.
description: The final handover ceremony marking completion of all sixty library corners, with student librarians demonstrating the lending register.
highlights: Student librarians ran the register demonstration
